/nexlev-series/abstract/dravmo.html.description: Dravmo is a play structure from the Abstract series in our NexLev range, held up by wavy poles in several colours instead of straight posts. Between the poles there are climbing panels, a bridge and slides, including a tube slide that shows clearly in the top view. Children cross the bridge, pick a climber and come down by whichever slide is free. It takes 25 to 30 children at a time. The product area is 27'4" x 20'4" and the safe play area is 33'4" x 26'4", which suits a township park or a large school ground. Play here builds problem solving, focus, motor skills and self control. Its pipes, moulded parts, laminates and rope come with our 3-year warranty. Tell us the ages you expect and we will check the fit.
/nexlev-series/abstract/dravmo.html.spec_paragraph: Dravmo's wavy poles are the main structure, so they are set self-standing or grouted with care to keep the frame true. The tube slide and other slides are roto-moulded. Keep the 33'4" x 26'4" safe zone clear, lay impact flooring under the bridge and climbers, and inspect bridge fixings regularly.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Series copy calls the range wooden, but the warranty line covers only galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Confirm materials and any warranty on timber.

/nexlev-series/abstract/ernoto.html.description: Ernoto stacks open cubes into a tower, with a pink spiral tube slide on one side and a net crawl tunnel on the other. Children climb from cube to cube, crawl through the net tunnel and take the slide down, so the tower suits active groups who like to explore. It holds 30 to 35 children and its product area is 23'9" x 23'2", almost square. That shape fits the centre of a society garden or a square school yard. Skills listed for Ernoto include exploring, building strength and emotional intelligence. It comes in a multi-colour scheme as part of our NexLev Abstract series. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope are covered for 3 years. Ask us for a layout drawing with the safe zone marked.
/nexlev-series/abstract/ernoto.html.spec_paragraph: Ernoto's cube frame is galvanised pipe, with a roto-moulded tube slide and a play rope crawl tunnel. It is installed self-standing or grouted. We will mark the exact safe zone on your drawing, with room for the spiral slide exit. Check the net tunnel and the joints between cubes during maintenance.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Safe play area 29'9" x 9'2" is smaller than the product area 23'9" x 23'2". Left out of the copy; probably 29'2".

/nexlev-series/abstract/eromofy.html.description: Eromofy brings a beach feel to a play area, with green poles shaped like palm trees holding up its platforms. A rope net bridge links the platforms and a green slide brings children back to the ground. The finish is Sea Green. Eromofy takes 35 to 40 children, covers 27' x 20'4", and needs a safe play area of 33' x 26'4". Resorts, coastal townships and society clubhouses often look for this kind of theme. Crossing the net bridge together builds concentration, strength, hand-eye coordination and team building. It belongs to the NexLev Abstract series. A 3-year warranty applies to the galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Call +91 902 830 2266 and tell us about your site.
/nexlev-series/abstract/eromofy.html.spec_paragraph: The palm poles and platforms sit on a galvanised pipe structure, with a roto-moulded slide and a play rope net bridge. It is installed self-standing or grouted. In coastal sites, rinse salt deposits off metal parts during routine cleaning. Check the bridge net for wear and keep the 33' x 26'4" zone clear.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.

/nexlev-series/abstract/rengvo.html.description: Rengvo is the Abstract play structure with built-in shade. Sail shades stretch over its platforms, which helps on hot afternoons in much of India. Underneath, children climb a ladder, cross a rope net bridge and come down by orange spiral slides. It takes 35 to 40 children, has a product area of 31' x 19'9" and needs a safe play area of 37' x 25'9". That makes it one of the larger pieces in the series, suited to parks and big school grounds. Rengvo lists leadership, self-directed play, concentration and motor skills among its skills. Its colours are multi-colour. The galvanised pipes, moulded parts, laminates and rope carry a 3-year warranty. Ask us for a quote.
/nexlev-series/abstract/rengvo.html.spec_paragraph: Rengvo's frame is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded spiral slides, a play rope bridge and fabric shade sails. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Check the sail fixings before and after the monsoon, as wind loads them. Inspect the net bridge and slide joints regularly.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Shade sails are not covered by the warranty line; confirm their warranty.

/nexlev-series/castle/arthur.html.description: Arthur is a wooden-look castle playground in brown, with battlements, flags and four towers. Turquoise and pink slides run off the towers, and the current series copy mentions cannons and fort details that add to the role play. Children defend the castle, move between towers and slide out, which keeps large groups busy. The listed capacity is 80 to 99 children. The product area is 34'4" x 29'6" and the safe play area is 40'4" x 35'6". It suits township parks, resorts and large schools that want a centrepiece. Skills listed are focus, self control and engaged learning. Every galvanised pipe, roto-moulded part, composite laminate and length of play rope on it is covered for 3 years. Send us your plot plan.
/nexlev-series/castle/arthur.html.spec_paragraph: Arthur is a large castle with four towers, so delivery and installation are planned around site access for the parts. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Keep the full 40'4" x 35'6" zone clear, with impact flooring at every slide exit. Inspect tower joints and the flags at each service.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Series copy calls the range wooden, but the warranty line covers only galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Confirm materials and any warranty on timber.
Capacity '80 - 99' looks very high for a 34'4" x 29'6" structure (same on Gonthina and Palamu). Confirm.

/nexlev-series/castle/gonthina.html.description: Gonthina is a twin-tower fort in brown with green tube slides. A rope bridge links the two towers, spiral slides come down each side, and a net tunnel gives a crawling route between them. The design suits play that moves between two bases, such as two teams holding a tower each. The listed colours are Sea Green and Forest Green. Gonthina covers 42'7" x 27'11" and needs a safe play area of 48'7" x 33'11", so it is planned for large parks and township grounds. Our sheet lists room for 80 to 99 children at once. Making connections, taking on challenges and self-directed play are its listed skills. Our 3-year warranty covers its main materials. Ask us for a layout drawing.
/nexlev-series/castle/gonthina.html.spec_paragraph: Gonthina's two towers and bridge sit on galvanised pipe, with roto-moulded tube slides and play rope for the bridge and tunnel. It is installed self-standing or grouted. The 48'7" x 33'11" zone must stay clear, and the rope bridge and net tunnel should be checked for wear at each service.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Product area, safe area, capacity and skills are identical to Palamu. Possible copy-paste; confirm.
Capacity '80 - 99' looks very high.

/nexlev-series/castle/palamu.html.description: Palamu is a castle playground built round a single hexagonal fort tower. Orange and blue tube slides radiate out from the tower like spokes, and flags and a cannon sit on top. With slides on several sides, children can leave the fort in different directions, which spreads a crowd. It is finished in multi-colour. Its product area is 42'7" x 27'11", with a safe play area of 48'7" x 33'11", and it can take 80 to 99 children. Skills listed include making connections, taking on challenges and self-directed play. Palamu suits large parks, resorts and schools that want one tall focal point. The galvanised pipe, moulded parts, laminates and rope are covered for 3 years. Call us to plan the site.
/nexlev-series/castle/palamu.html.spec_paragraph: Palamu's hexagonal tower is galvanised pipe, with roto-moulded tube slides set around it. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Each slide exit needs clear run-out space inside the safe zone. Inspect the slide joints, tower panels and cannon fixings during regular maintenance.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Product area, safe area, capacity and skills are identical to Gonthina, although the images show a different layout (single hexagonal tower). Confirm Palamu's own figures.

/nexlev-series/castle/sunspear.html.description: Sunspear is a brown fort playground with Cherry Red tube slides and rope net climbers. A climbing wall rises on one face, nets lead up the others, and the red tube slides wind back down. It suits children who want a harder climb, and it gives older groups a fort to defend. Sunspear takes 20 to 25 children. Its product area is 34'1" x 28'3". The skills it builds include team building, leadership and seeing a game from another child's side. Parks, resorts and schools with a dedicated older-children zone are a good match. Its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded slides, laminates and nets are under a 3-year warranty. Tell us your site size for a layout drawing.
/nexlev-series/castle/sunspear.html.spec_paragraph: Sunspear's fort is built on galvanised pipe, with roto-moulded tube slides and play rope nets. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Lay impact flooring below the climbing wall and nets as well as at the slide exits. Check net tension and wall holds at each service.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Safe play area 40'11" x 34'3" adds 6'10" to the length but 6' to the width; other castles add 6' both ways. Possible typo for 40'1". Left out of the copy.
Capacity '20 - 25' is far lower than the other castles (80 to 99) of similar size. Confirm.
Skill 'Perspective talking' is probably 'Perspective taking'.

/nexlev-series/escapade/aviator.html.description: Aviator is an adventure play structure shaped like an aeroplane, made almost entirely of rope net. Children climb through the fuselage and wings, and two purple slides bring them down at the front. From above, the frame reads clearly as an aircraft. It comes in Lemon Green. Aviator takes 40 to 45 children, covers 36'8" x 30'6", and needs a safe play area of 42'8" x 36'6", so it suits large parks, resorts and school grounds. Net climbing builds strength and confidence, and the listed skills also include leadership and self control. It is part of the Escapade series in our NexLev range. We give a 3-year warranty on its galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us for a quote.
/nexlev-series/escapade/aviator.html.spec_paragraph: Aviator's aircraft frame is galvanised pipe, strung with play rope nets and fitted with roto-moulded slides. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Because so much of it is net, check rope tension, knots and fixing clamps regularly. Lay impact flooring under the whole net area.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Series copy calls the range wooden, but the warranty line covers only galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Confirm materials and any warranty on timber.

/nexlev-series/escapade/combat.html.description: Combat is built as an obstacle course. Children work through a climbing wall, monkey bars, hanging rings and bridges, then finish on a red slide. It suits older children who want a challenge, and it works for timed races at school sports days. The structure takes 30 to 35 children, has a product area of 30'2" x 21'2" and a safe play area of 36'2" x 27'2". Combat lists confidence building, problem solving, creative thinking and strength among its skills. It comes in a multi-colour finish as part of our NexLev Escapade series. Warranty on the pipe frame, the moulded and laminate parts and the play rope runs for 3 years. Send us your plot size and the ages you plan for.
/nexlev-series/escapade/combat.html.spec_paragraph: Combat's course is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded and composite parts and play rope on the bridges. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Children hang from the monkey bars and rings, so lay impact flooring under the full length, and check ring and bar fixings at every service.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.

/nexlev-series/escapade/crossette.html.description: Crossette is an adventure structure in Mango Yellow and Cherry Red built for children who like to keep moving. Net bridges, a wavy rope bridge and a crawl tunnel link its climbers, and a slide gives the way down. Each crossing is a different challenge, so children choose their own path. The structure takes 30 to 35 children. It covers 29'6" x 26'5", with a safe play area of 34'6" x 31'5". The listed skills are emotional intelligence, leadership and self-directed play. It belongs to our NexLev Escapade series and suits parks, societies and school grounds with a near-square space. Our 3-year warranty applies to its galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, laminates and play rope. Ask us for a layout drawing.
/nexlev-series/escapade/crossette.html.spec_paragraph: Crossette relies on rope bridges and a crawl tunnel, so most of its maintenance is net care: check knots, clamps and tension regularly. The frame is galvanised pipe and the slide is roto-moulded. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Keep impact flooring under every bridge.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.

/nexlev-series/escapade/frisk.html.description: Frisk is the compact member of the Escapade series. A Blue frame with colourful pole tops holds a rope net platform, climbing poles, seats and a slide, all within a product area of 20' x 10'. The safe play area is 26' x 16', so Frisk fits a smaller society garden, a clubhouse lawn or a preschool. It takes 15 to 20 children. Children climb the poles, rest on the net platform and slide down, and the seats give a spot to sit between turns. Listed skills include emotional intelligence, leadership and self-directed play. We cover the galvanised frame, the moulded slide, the laminates and the rope net for 3 years. Call +91 902 830 2266 and we will check the fit.
/nexlev-series/escapade/frisk.html.spec_paragraph: Frisk uses a galvanised pipe frame, a play rope net platform and a roto-moulded slide. It is set self-standing or grouted. Its small footprint makes it easy to place, but keep the full 26' x 16' zone clear. Check the climbing poles and net fixings during routine maintenance.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Skills are identical to Crossette and Capstone.

/nexlev-series/escapade/frolic.html.description: Frolic is a play circuit without a tower. Hexagonal net platforms, net climbers, wooden stepping beams, stepping posts and a trail of stepping pods form a balance course children can run in a loop. It suits active groups and works well beside a taller structure that already has slides. Frolic takes 30 to 35 children. The product area is 18' x 16'8" and the safe play area is 24' x 22'8". Balancing along the trail builds confidence, strength, leadership and self control. Frolic is finished in mixed colours. The 3-year warranty covers the pipes, moulded parts, laminates and play rope. Tell us what else is planned on your site and we will design around it.
/nexlev-series/escapade/frolic.html.spec_paragraph: Frolic stays low, so children fall shorter distances, but impact flooring is still needed along the whole trail. The posts and platforms are galvanised pipe with play rope nets, installed self-standing or grouted. Check the stepping pods and beams for loose fixings at each service.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Series copy calls the range wooden, but the warranty line covers only galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Confirm materials and any warranty on timber.
Capacity '30 - 35' looks high for an 18' x 16'8" balance circuit.

/nexlev-series/escapade/thunder-bolt.htm.description: Thunder Bolt is a climbing course in Cherry Red. Children go up a rope ladder or a climbing wall to a hexagonal net deck, travel along an overhead ring traverse and come down a twin slide. It is meant for confident climbers and gives a group plenty to try in a long, narrow footprint of 28'1" x 15'1". Thunder Bolt takes 30 to 35 children. Its listed skills are exploring, confidence building, social skills and critical thinking. It belongs to our NexLev Escapade series and suits schools, parks and resorts with a strip of open ground. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope have a 3-year warranty. Ask us to mark the safe zone on your drawing.
/nexlev-series/escapade/thunder-bolt.htm.spec_paragraph: Thunder Bolt's frame is galvanised pipe, with a roto-moulded twin slide and play rope ladder and deck. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Lay impact flooring under the ring traverse and climbing wall. Inspect the rings, ladder and deck net regularly.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Safe play area is identical to the product area (28'1" x 15'1"), so no safe zone is given. Left out of the copy.
